content.value_statement: Raw data often lacks a clear buyer, use case, specification, and price. This skill structures product discovery, MVP validation, pricing, and launch preparation.
actual_capabilities: Assesses product potential using describability, deliverability, repeatability, usability, and stability.
Identifies internal, industry, and buyer-driven scenarios for available data resources.
Creates quantified value hypotheses and seven-element product designs.
Plans MVP creation and validation with one to three seed customers.
Produces pricing guidance, launch materials, quality checks, and iteration roadmaps.
limitations: It cannot verify demand without interviews, usage evidence, or payment signals from real customers.
Pricing ranges require current cost, market, and buyer-value evidence.
It does not replace legal, regulatory, privacy, or licensed professional review.
External policies and exchange listing rules may change after the knowledge base date.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Data Opportunities
use_cases.description: Evaluate available datasets and rank product opportunities by buyer pain, feasibility, and measurable value.

use_cases.title: Design a Validatable MVP
use_cases.description: Define product specifications, sample outputs, validation questions, and success criteria before major development.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Product Launch
use_cases.description: Develop positioning, pricing logic, product documentation, quality checks, and listing preparation.

prompt_templates.title: Assess One Dataset
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess [dataset] using the five productization questions. Identify missing evidence and recommend the next practical step.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner assessment of a single data resource

prompt_templates.title: Discover Buyer Scenarios
prompt_templates.prompt: Find three product scenarios for [data resource] in [industry]. Rank them by buyer pain, measurable value, feasibility, and repeatability.

prompt_templates.title: Design and Validate an MVP
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a seven-element data product for [scenario]. Define its MVP, seed-customer plan, validation questions, success metrics, and decision thresholds.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Incubation Roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a phased incubation roadmap for [portfolio]. Include prioritization, value hypotheses, product specifications, governance gates, pricing evidence, launch dependencies, and iteration decisions.

output_examples.input: Assess our anonymized machine maintenance records for product potential.
output: Strong describability and repeatability, but buyer requirements and delivery frequency need evidence.
Test a predictive maintenance benchmark with two equipment operators.
Proceed only after validating measurable downtime reduction and permitted usage rights.

output_examples.input: Create an MVP plan for a retail demand benchmark.
output: Package regional category indices with weekly updates, documented coverage, and quality thresholds.
Recruit three retailers and compare forecast accuracy against their current baseline.
Advance when repeated usage and credible payment interest meet agreed thresholds.

output_examples.input: Suggest pricing evidence for a logistics performance dataset.
output: Estimate production and support costs for the minimum sustainable price.
Quantify buyer savings from fewer delays and better carrier selection.
Compare equivalent market offers before testing a limited pilot price.

best_practices: Start with verified buyer problems, then match available data to those problems.
Use measured behavior and payment signals instead of favorable interview comments.
Treat data rights, privacy, quality, and repeatable delivery as launch gates.
anti_patterns: Do not build a complete product before testing a focused MVP.
Do not claim financial value without evidence, assumptions, and measurement methods.
Do not sell internally collected data before reviewing rights and compliance.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide dataset scope, fields, update frequency, quality, rights, current users, candidate buyers, and known business problems.

faq.question: Can this skill identify product ideas from raw data?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares data capabilities with internal, industry, and buyer problems, then ranks testable scenarios.

faq.question: Does every data product need external buyers?
faq.answer: No. Internal products can prove cost reduction or operational value before external commercialization.

faq.question: How does it validate a product concept?
faq.answer: It defines an MVP, recruits seed customers, records actual usage, and tests value, usability, and payment interest.

faq.question: Can it provide a final price?
faq.answer: It provides pricing logic and test ranges. A final price requires current costs, market comparisons, and buyer-value evidence.

faq.question: Does it provide legal or regulatory approval?
faq.answer: No. Qualified professionals must review ownership, privacy, licensing, contracts, and applicable regulations.
